name: Disk Cleaner & Info
tagline: Reclaim space and see what's using it — temp/cache cleanup, large-file finder, live system monitor.
description: Scan and clean temporary files, browser and app caches, and the Recycle Bin (with a safe preview and size report); find the largest files and folders eating your disk; visualize disk usage by folder; and watch live CPU, memory, disk and network usage. Deletions go to the Recycle Bin by default. Runs locally, nothing uploaded.
